title: Discrete {Gd4M} (M = GdIII or CoII) pentanuclear complexes: a new class of metal-organophosphate molecular coolers

synthesis.procedure: Main text: dippH2, Gd(NO3)3·6H2O and tmeda (1:1:2) in methanol gave 1. SI experimental section (ambient air, no special precautions): to Gd(NO3)3·xH2O (0.045 g, 0.10 mmol) in methanol (10 mL) was added dippH2 (0.026 g, 0.10 mmol) in methanol (10 mL); after stirring, tmeda (printed as 0.023 mg, 0.20 mmol) was added. The mixture was heated at 70 °C for 3 h, cooled to room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate crystallized at room temperature. Crystals formed from the mother liquor within two weeks.

reagents.name: N,N,N',N'-tetramethylethylenediamine
reagents.amount: 0.023 mg, 0.20 mmol (as printed in SI; main-text ratio 1:1:2)

synthesis.time: 3 h heating; crystals within two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction with stirring and heating, then filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; clear filtrate kept at room temperature; crystals from the mother liquor

properties.summary: Five Gd(III) ions are weakly antiferromagnetically coupled. The experimental magnetocaloric entropy change reaches 25.8 J kg−1 K−1 (7 T, 3 K), close to the theoretical maximum of 29.6 J kg−1 K−1, and DFT gives a comparable −ΔSm of 26.9 J kg−1 K−1.

synthesis.procedure: Main text describes diffusion of CH2Cl2 into a DMSO–MeOH solution of Gd(NO3)3·6H2O and preformed [Co(dipp)(DMSO)]4 (A) but gives no quantities. SI: a methanol solution of Gd(NO3)3·xH2O (0.090 g, 0.20 mmol, 10 mL) was added to [Co(dipp)(DMSO)]4 (0.079 g, 0.05 mmol) in DMSO (5 mL). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 15–20 min to a light pink solution, filtered, and layered with CH2Cl2 (5 mL). Blue crystals formed at room temperature after two weeks.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing followed by CH2Cl2 layering/diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; CH2Cl2 (5 mL) layered over the filtrate and left at room temperature to give blue crystals

properties.summary: Four Gd(III) and one Co(II) show weak antiferromagnetic exchange, with a larger Co–Gd coupling and Co(II) anisotropy that reduce the MCE relative to the Gd5 analogue. Experimental −ΔSm is 20.3 J kg−1 K−1 (7 T, 3 K) versus a theoretical maximum of 27 J kg−1 K−1.
